title: Centrally Located 6 bed apt near Marathon Village!
description:
Experience the heart of Nashville from our spacious 5-bedroom, 6-bed apartment, perfect for groups! Located near Marathon Village, you're minutes away from the city's best attractions. Enjoy the comfort of a gated complex, with one dedicated parking space and free street parking available for additional cars. This stylish, modern unit offers all the amenities you need for a memorable stay. Ideal for families and friends looking to explore Music City in style and comfort!

The space
Welcome to our spacious and modern 5-bedroom apartment, perfectly located near Marathon Village in the heart of Nashville, TN. This beautifully designed unit comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with its 6 cozy beds. Enjoy the convenience of a gated complex providing enhanced security and peace of mind. The apartment includes one dedicated parking space, and there is ample free street parking available for any additional vehicles. 

Our location provides the unique advantage of being close to downtown while remaining budget-friendly for our guests. Situated in an up-and-coming area just minutes from vibrant Broadway, our property offers both convenience and affordability.

Nashville, like many larger cities, boasts a diverse population within its downtown, and our neighborhood reflects this diversity. It's a dynamic experience, somewhat similar to the lively atmosphere one might encounter while visiting a larger city. 

Our goal is to ensure that everyone has a safe, positive and enjoyable time while staying with us in Music City. Our team is available throughout your stay should you have any questions or feedback.

Guest access
Entire home

Other things to note
Please note that is a second-story unit.
